test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sparse_http_export ( id UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64, u4 UInt64, u5 UInt64, u6 UInt64, u7 UInt64, u8 UInt64, u9 UInt64, u10 UInt64, u11 UInt64, u12 UInt64, u13 UInt64, u14 UInt64, u15 UInt64, u16 UInt64, u17 UInt64, u18 UInt64, u19 UInt64, u20 UInt64, f1 Float64, f2 Float64, f3 Float64, f4 Float64, f5 Float64, s1 String, s2 String, s3 String, s4 String, s5 String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.9
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sparse_http_export (id, u1, s1) SELECT number, number % 100 = 0 ? number : 0, number % 100 = 0 ? toString(number) : '' FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: ${CLICKHOUSE_CURL} "${CLICKHOUSE_URL}" --data-binary "SELECT * FROM sparse_http_export WHERE id < 2000000 FORMAT Parquet" -o /dev/null
